items.title: Route `/pipelines` renders index redirect
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /pipelines
THEN the index redirect screen is displayed at that URL
AND index redirects to the first Applications tab, preserving query string and history state

items.title: Route `/pipelines/create` renders CreatePipeline
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /pipelines/create
THEN the create pipeline screen is displayed at that URL
AND navigation is blocked while the form is dirty

items.title: Route `/pipelines/:tab` renders Pipelines
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /pipelines/:tab

AND the location, parameters and history behave exactly as in the baseline application

items.title: Action on pipelines: generate content streaming via onClick/onGenerate/onStop
acceptance: GIVEN the pipelines screen is displayed with the relevant entity available
WHEN the user activates the control wired to generate content streaming
THEN a POST request to /elitea_core/predict_llm/prompt_lib/{projectId} is dispatched
AND the visible outcome matches the baseline: success updates the view, failure surfaces an error without losing user input

items.title: Action on pipelines: stop llm task via onClick/onGenerate/onStop
acceptance: GIVEN the pipelines screen is displayed with the relevant entity available
WHEN the user activates the control wired to stop llm task
THEN a DELETE request to /elitea_core/task/prompt_lib/{projectId}/{task_id} is dispatched
AND the visible outcome matches the baseline: success updates the view, failure surfaces an error without losing user input

items.title: Action on pipelines: update pipeline trigger via onClick/onSubmit/onValueChange
acceptance: GIVEN the pipelines screen is displayed with the relevant entity available
WHEN the user activates the control wired to update pipeline trigger
THEN a PUT request to /elitea_core/pipeline_trigger/prompt_lib/{projectId}/pipeline/{versionId}/trigger is dispatched
AND the visible outcome matches the baseline: success updates the view, failure surfaces an error without losing user input
